sentences.text: The only known remains of this creature are a collection of separate contour feathers.
Scientists classify it as a bird, perhaps a member of the Enantiornithes group.
Lacasa-Ruiz named the genus and the species viai in 1985.
This single find represents the entire recorded fossil history of the genus.
Its parent group is the Archaeornithes.
It lived in the Lower Cretaceous of Spain within the La Pedrera de Rúbies Formation during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
